description: Apply an unmodified S1C auxiliary with one correction weight for high-support prior segments and one for low-support prior segments. Fit S1C without the outer section. Pick weights on inner leave-one-section-out predictions on the historical proxy. High-support weight cannot exceed low-support weight. Maximize the mean of the defined per-section r-squared scores only when all sections have a defined score. Prefer smaller sums of weights on ties. No correction without direct measurement. Use own and nearby eligible point coverage as a proxy for reliability.
